data.label: include
data.reason_zh: RefCon以自精炼与自对比迭代提取更高质量记忆，并随轨迹增多持续改进，属记忆管理机制改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: We propose RefCon, which combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality memories without gold labels.
scope_support.object_quote: Context-evolving agents therefore need memory extraction methods that improve with more test-time compute without relying on gold labels.
scope_support.persistence_quote: RefCon maintains favorable efficiency and continues to improve as more trajectories are used
